build_arg_parser: build an ArgumentParser for the uCO3D dataset download CLI with configurable options
download_dataset: download the uCO3D dataset with parallel workers, checksum verification, and modality filtering
download_with_huggingface: download the uCO3D dataset from HuggingFace using the facebook/uco3d repository
download_small_subset: download a small debug subset of 52 videos from the uCO3D dataset for testing
download_with_categories: download specific uCO3D super-categories like vegetables_and_legumes and stationery
